changes.title: Readable on any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage opens as a shrunken desktop page. The sketch is built for the screen it is read on.

changes.title: Tap to call and request a quote.
changes.text: Your number is plain text today and there is no quote request. Both sit at the top of the sketch.

changes.title: Product lines up front.
changes.text: Connectors, OEM sensors and process equipment are each one tap away from the homepage.
